description: A man in a black frock coat and red fez holds up an unrolled blank scroll in a garden of roses, with a crowd behind him: men in red fezzes, a bearded man in a white turban and brown robe, and a uniformed officer with gold epaulettes and a plumed bicorne on the right. Behind them are crenellated stone walls, bare trees and a stormy grey sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
